modules.alt: Sleep Dentistry at My Dear Dentistry

modules.html:
Sleep better with dental support

Sleep issues, like snoring and obstructive sleep apnea, affect your energy, focus, and long-term health. As trusted Montrose sleep dentists, we provide comfortable, non-invasive solutions that help you breathe easier and sleep more soundly.

Patients come to us for airway-focused care from River Oaks, Greenway/Upper Kirby, West University, and the rest of the areas we serve, and our office is a short drive from all of them.

At My Dear Dentist, we take a whole-body approach to care. That means not only improving your smile, but also supporting your airway health, your nervous system, and your quality of life. Our personalized treatments are backed by advanced diagnostics, gentle technology, and a team that truly listens.

Signs you’re not sleeping well

Sleep-disordered breathing is more common than you think, and our team is here to help.

items.text: Snore loudly or gasp for air while sleeping
Wake up feeling groggy, even after a full night’s sleep
Grind your teeth or clench your jaw at night
Have been diagnosed with mild to moderate sleep apnea

items.title: Oral Appliance Therapy
items.html: Custom-made appliances gently reposition your jaw during sleep, keeping your airway open and reducing snoring or apnea episodes, without masks or machines.

items.title: Sleep Apnea Consultations
items.html: We work with your medical provider or sleep physician to review sleep studies, assess symptoms, and determine the best non-invasive dental solution for your needs. Explore Sleep Apnea

items.title: TMJ & Bruxism Relief
items.html: Jaw pain, teeth grinding, and muscle tension can all be related to sleep issues. We identify contributing factors and offer relief with targeted, conservative treatments.

items.title: Whole-Body Wellness Approach
items.html: Sleep affects everything, from heart health to mood. Our team connects the dots between your sleep, airway, oral health, and overall well-being.

items.title: Personalized Treatment Plans
items.html: No two patients are the same. We take time to understand your lifestyle, symptoms, and goals to create a plan that works for you.
